description: Browse the WHO Global Health Observatory indicator catalog with pagination. Use when you want to explore indicators without a keyword, or to page through the full catalog. Use who_search_indicators when you have a keyword to narrow the results.

limit.description: Number of indicators to return per page. Default 50, max 500.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the catalog. Default 0. Read hasMore and nextOffset from the response to continue paging. An offset at or beyond totalCount returns an empty indicators array, not an error.

name: who_list_indicators

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when more indicators remain beyond this page. Pair with nextOffset to continue.

items.description: An indicator entry with its code and name.

indicatorCode.description: Unique indicator code used in who_query_indicator_data, e.g. "WHOSIS_000001".

indicatorName.description: Full indicator name, e.g. "Life expectancy at birth (years)".

nextOffset.description: Offset to request for the next page. Absent when this page reached the end of the catalog.

notice.description: Present when the requested limit was clamped, indicators remain beyond this page, or the requested offset ran past the end of the catalog. Explains how to reach the remaining indicators.

offset.description: Zero-based offset this page started at.

pageInfo.description: Human-readable page position, in the form "offset {offset}, showing {returned} of {totalCount}". Use to construct the next offset.

totalCount.description: Total number of indicators in the GHO catalog.

title: List WHO GHO Indicators
